description: This file defines a template class 'BinaryInterface' within the 'WebSockets' namespace, providing an interface for sending messages and setting message handlers over WebSocket connections. It includes external dependencies on websocketpp and logging utilities, and manages message handling via function objects.

classes.name: BinaryInterface
classes.description: A template class providing WebSocket binary message sending and handler setup functionalities.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message through the derived class implementation.

methods.name: setOnMessageHandler
methods.description: Sets a callback function to handle incoming messages.
